basics.name: Matti Saarela
basics.label: Experienced Software Engineer and Partner
basics.summary:
Matti is a security-minded software developer with a strong focus on backend development and integrations.

He has extensive experience in developing and designing demanding and business-critical systems across different domains and various technologies. Secure web development and networking are his key strengths, and he has a broad understanding of how data flows securely from end to end.

Matti has adopted recent AI tools for smarter development and chewing better solutions for upcoming challenges. He’s also poking around with running AI locally.

x-keyRoles.title: Lead Developer
x-keyRoles.description: He has worked as a lead developer in teams, guiding others to do the right thing.

x-keyRoles.title: Infra / DevOps Magician
x-keyRoles.description: Eats pipelines for breakfast and spits artifacts all around. He packs stuff in containers while still keeping things secure.

projects.name: Digital service platform microservice refactoring
projects.description: The client's digital service platform is a modern service where pharmacies, hospitals, health stores, pharmaceutical and health product companies, and other healthcare operators can connect in a new way. Matti's task was to refactor deprecated microservices from the Lagom framework into a system powered by Spring Boot and the Axon framework.

projects.name: Application Platform team
projects.description: Developing and maintaining Application Platform tools for deploying and managing application infrastructure on Azure and on-premises.

projects.name: Security Champion
projects.description: Worked as a Security Champion with another developer, focusing on security audits, DevSecOps methods and tools development.

projects.name: Application Logging and Monitoring system
projects.description: Application Monitoring system is a centralised logging and monitoring system. It collects logs and metrics from all applications running in the on-premises environment.
keywords: ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, and Beats)

projects.name: Certification and test application rewrite for the national electricity data hub
projects.description: Worked as part of the team rewriting the certification and test application for a national electricity data hub, which is a centralised information exchange system for the Finnish electricity retail market.
